infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BoltPocket accesses your local network when you use local models, MCP, SSH, websites, or project capabilities that you configured.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to use the camera, or take photos to attach to conversations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to use the microphone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BoltPocket includes location support for authorized websites and project H5 apps. It does not request background location; access is limited to while you use the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to access your location while in use.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to read device motion and orientation for games and interactions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow photo selection for website uploads or conversation attachments.
